_meta.purpose: Measurement store for the veto taxonomy. The envelope reads every numeric value from here; it never reads a number out of the taxonomy.
_meta.honesty_rule: A profile whose provenance is not 'measurement' forces mode=simulation on every decision it produces. Those decisions must never be presented as hardware decisions. Replace sim_reference_v0 with a profile built from data/calibration measurements of your own rig (D-T06) before claiming any hardware result.
how_to_add_a_measured_profile: 1. Measure the rig: max safe speed, stall force, travel limits, camera p95 frame interval, encoder p95 interval, cloud RTT variance.
2. Copy the sim_reference_v0 block, set provenance to 'measurement', and give every parameter a provenance entry with kind='measurement' and a measurement_id.
3. Add the matching entry to the profile's 'measurements' map: id -> {method, instrument, value, unit, measured_at, notes}.
4. Point active_profile at it and run: python scripts/check_param_provenance.py --strict
5. Every degraded value must still be strictly more conservative; the loader refuses to start otherwise.

sim_reference_v0.description: Single-axis pusher, 370 mm of usable travel. Numbers chosen so the fixture suite exercises every rule with a clear margin. NOT measured on any physical device.
sim_reference_v0.provenance_note: Nothing in this profile was measured. It exists so the envelope, its tests and the simulator can run before a rig is instrumented.

rig.actuator: single-axis pusher on a linear rail
rig.interlock: electromechanical relay in the actuator power path

V2_KEEP_OUT_OCCUPIED.detection_min_confi.note: 0.0 accepts any confident-enough detector result; replace with the measured false-negative rate crossover.

V2_KEEP_OUT_OCCUPIED.detection_method_pr.note: Ordering is a design choice, not a measurement.

V2_KEEP_OUT_OCCUPIED.min_blob_area_px.note: Placeholder for the smallest intruder the camera must catch; measure against your own optics and working distance.

V2_KEEP_OUT_OCCUPIED.consecutive_frames_.note: 1 by design: waiting for confirmation adds stop latency, which is worse than an occasional false positive.

V3_VELOCITY_LIMIT.max_velocity_mm_s.note: Placeholder for the maximum speed at which the rig stops inside the keep-out gap. Replace with a measured veto-to-stop distance.

V3_VELOCITY_LIMIT.max_accel_mm_s2.note: Driver-owned ramp limit; not consumed by the envelope.

V4_FORCE_LIMIT.max_force_n.note: Placeholder. A real value comes from a stall test on the actuator plus the application's pinch-force limit.

V4_FORCE_LIMIT.force_estimate_method.note: stall_current is an ESTIMATE, not a measurement of contact force; the UI and the trace must say so.

V5_WORKSPACE_BOUND.allowed_volume.note: Placeholder box for a 370 mm rail; measure the travel that the limit switches actually bound.

V5_WORKSPACE_BOUND.boundary_margin_mm.note: Placeholder. Derive from the measured overtravel after a stop command.

V6_COLLISION_PREDICTED.lookahead_ms.note: Placeholder. Should exceed the measured stop latency.

V6_COLLISION_PREDICTED.swept_volume_infl.note: Placeholder for calibration error plus end-effector half-width.

V7_SENSOR_STALE.camera_max_age_ms.note: Placeholder. Derive as p99 frame interval x 3 from a measured distribution.

V7_SENSOR_STALE.encoder_max_age_ms.note: Placeholder. Derive from the measured control-loop jitter.

V8_NETWORK_DEGRADED.window_ms.note: Placeholder. Must exceed the measured round-trip variance so a blip does not flap the mode.

V8_NETWORK_DEGRADED.allow_multi_step_pla.note: A policy switch, not a measurement. Planner-owned.

V8_NETWORK_DEGRADED.planner_source.note: A policy switch, not a measurement. Planner-owned.

V9_PLAN_MALFORMED.max_ttl_ms.note: Placeholder. Must exceed the measured plan-to-execute latency, or every plan expires.

V9_PLAN_MALFORMED.allow_limit_requests_a.note: Policy: a planner may not ask for more than the normal-mode ceiling and expect a clamp.

V10_HUMAN_PRESENCE.clear_hold_ms.note: Detector-owned hold time after the cell clears.
